subject: CS361
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all topics. The English selections are from highly authoritative channels with massive view counts. The Arabic selections are dominated by top-tier channels like Elzero Web School, which are benchmarks for quality in the region. For some topics, the pool of high-quality Arabic videos was limited, with many candidates failing view count or language gates (e.g., being for Java instead of JavaScript).

coverage.note: Most candidates were for the Java language or had views below the 3000 threshold.
Several high-view candidates were rejected for exceeding the 3600s duration limit.
Many candidates failed the view count gate (<3000).
Most candidates failed the view count gate (<3000) or were in English.
Several candidates were in English or failed the view count gate (<3000).
